messages:
maria: FYI seeing spike in 5xxs for /v1/generate in hosted-us-east — started ~09:12 UTC, p95 latency ~12s, lots of 504s.
raj: customer impact? which customers?
ian-support: multiple customers reporting timeouts, biggest is AcmeApp (high volume). They reported 504s for ~6min and queued retries.
ops-bot: Alert: hosted-us-east /v1/generate error-rate > 8% for 6m (rule: gateway-5xx-spike). Pager routed to @sre-oncall.
sre-oncall: Looking at apigw logs now. Noticing a high fraction of upstream 502/504 from inference-proxy to runtime. KV cache miss rate jumped, and connection errors to runtime nodes increased.
maria: Deploy at 09:05 by amy? any correlation?
deploy-bot: deploy-service: deploy amy/feature/kvcache-optim at 2026-03-17T09:05:12Z, sha=aa12bb3. No rollbacks.
amy: That deploy was pretty small, mostly config. Rolling it back now to rule out.
raj: Before rollback, can we reproduce? any single request pattern?
kelly: I see long tail seq_len on requests from AcmeApp (avg tokens ~1800) — they hit our burst limits. Also see persistent keepalive resets on NodeGroup-6.
sre-oncall: Repro steps: curl -v https://api.hosted.redwood/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"model":"rwd-7b","input":"<long prompt>"}' returns 504 with x-request-id and upstream timeout in trace.
ian-support: Provided x-request-ids from AcmeApp: rq_9a8b7c, rq_9a8b8d, rq_9a8b9e — all map to NodeGroup-6 with repeated connection resets.
sre-oncall: Mitigation idea: temporarily route traffic away from NodeGroup-6 and scale up NodeGroup-8, enable additional inference capacity, and throttle longest requests by default for hosted tier.
amy: Rolling traffic for /v1/generate to include eu-west fallback for new requests. Pushing routing patch (canary) now.
ops-bot: Runbook step: enable fallback routing -> triggered by @amy at 09:27 UTC.
kelly: Also increasing runtime pool size by +20% in us-east for next 10m.
raj: Can we rate-limit or block the long individual customers until we confirm stability?
ian-support: Reached out to AcmeApp — they confirmed they started a bulk test at 09:10 that amplified seq lengths. They've paused their run now.
sre-oncall: After routing change and scaling, errors fell to ~0.6% within 4m. p95 latency back to ~300ms.
maria: Good. Please capture root causes and action items for postmortem.
sre-oncall: Preliminary root cause: combination of sudden high-seqlen burst from a customer + keepalive resets / connection churn on NodeGroup-6 causing upstream timeouts and cascade to API gateway. Secondary contributor: KV cache cold start magnified cost per request.
amy: Action items: 1) Improve per-customer burst protection (rate limits and default max-seqlen) — owner: raj, ETA: 1 week. 2) Investigate NodeGroup-6 keepalive resets and fix underlying networking config — owner: kelly, ETA: 3 days. 3) Add metric and alert for rapid KV cache miss ratio increase — owner: maria, ETA: 3 days. 4) Add graceful degraded fallback to smaller model variant automatically when seq_len > threshold — owner: eng-runtime, ETA: 2 weeks. 5) Customer comms & support playbook for bulk tests — owner: ian-support, ETA: 2 days. 6) Postmortem doc with timeline and attach traces — owner: amy, ETA: 48 hours.
raj: Also propose a short-term mitigation: patch API to cap request tokens at 2000 for hosted free/standard tiers and return 413 for over-limit with guidance. Owner: product & api team, ETA: 2 days.
kelly: Investigating NodeGroup-6 logs: seeing TCP FIN bursts from kube-proxy sidecar at ~09:11-09:18 — likely NAT table exhaustion. Opening infra ticket.
sre-oncall: Adding follow-up: add circuit-breaker per node to avoid complete churn, and increase keepalive timeout tuning.
ian-support: Customer impact summary: AcmeApp saw ~1200 failing requests across 6 minutes, they resumed after pause. No SLA credits requested yet, but support recommended outreach.
amy: Posting a short incident summary to #all-hands once postmortem ready.
maria: Thanks team. I'll create the postmortem doc skeleton and attach traces + sample request ids.
ian-support: Action item: send draft comms to AcmeApp with apology and mitigation steps — done (cc @amy).
ops-bot: Incident resolved: error-rate normalized at 09:31 UTC.
sre-oncall: Last note — capture system-ids and add to postmortem: NodeGroup-6 (ng-6-us-east-2), KVCache-l1-pool (cold), RouteTable-A (fallthrough to ng-6).
amy: Closing war room for now, moving to postmortem thread. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
